status: finite N=1 SYM vacuum, Witten-index, soft-threshold and AdS-supergravity audit; not a constructive mass-gap proof

holomorphicVacua.protected: discrete chiral Z_2N to Z_2 breaking, N branches, condensate phases and holomorphic superpotential extrema
holomorphicVacua.notProtected: the non-holomorphic Kahler metric and physical non-BPS masses

kahlerCounterexample.localToy: dimensionless quadratic fluctuation model with kinetic coefficient Z and W''=N/S
kahlerCounterexample.decision: Identical protected extrema and condensates admit continuously different curvature scales when the unprotected Kahler metric changes; VY holomorphy alone is not a mass calculation.

wittenIndexWitness.spectrumDefinition: three bosonic E=0 vacua plus one boson-fermion pair at E=epsilon
wittenIndexWitness.decision: The index is invariant while the first paired excitation can approach zero or infinity. It neither lower-bounds the gap nor proves a continuum theory with reflection positivity and clustering.

softMassVacuumSplitting.formula: Delta E_k=-2 m_lambda Lambda_SYM^3 cos[(theta+2 pi k)/N]+O(m_lambda^2)
softMassVacuumSplitting.warning: vacuum-energy splitting between branches is not the physical particle mass gap

softDecouplingMatching.continuityObstacle: No holomorphic or index theorem supplies a uniform positive spectral bound through the uncontrolled intermediate region and into nonsupersymmetric pure Yang-Mills.

ospAdSBridge.bosonicSubgroup: Sp(4,R) is locally isomorphic to Spin(2,3)
ospAdSBridge.qualification: requires local N=1 supersymmetry, a gravitino and a supergravity completion; it is not implied by the bosonic Spin(2,3) connection

formulae: W_cond,k=N Lambda_SYM^3 exp(2 pi i k/N)
Lambda_grav=-3 m_3/2^2 in an unbroken supersymmetric AdS vacuum
supergravityCondensateWitness.decision: The same condensate permits different AdS radii or Minkowski space because W0 is independent. Kahler data, the gauge kinetic function, SUSY breaking and uplift add further freedom.

protected: Witten index and index-stable vacuum multiplicity
holomorphic condensate phases and anomaly branch structure
holomorphic superpotential data and applicable BPS central charges
m_3/2=ell^-1 in an unbroken N=1 AdS supergravity vacuum
notProtected: a numerical positive non-BPS physical mass gap
the composite-field Kahler metric or full spectral density
uniform continuity from small soft mass to the pure-YM decoupling limit
constructive existence, reflection positivity and infinite-volume clustering
the constant W0, uplift sector or cosmological vacuum energy
identification of hidden Lambda_SYM with Lambda_QCD or the Spin(2,3) radius
reopeningConditions: a uniform positive spectral bound along the entire soft-deformation path
a constructive continuum theorem transporting that bound to pure Yang-Mills
a UV boundary law fixing the gauge coupling, Kahler data, W0, SUSY breaking and embedding together
protectionBoundary.programmeDecision: SUSY supplies exact neighbouring-theory vacuum data and an optional OSp(1|4) bridge, but no protected pure-YM gap or shared QCD-AdS scale.
